WITH locked_parents AS (
      SELECT j.name, j.id
      FROM jobs.job_common j
      WHERE j.blocking
        AND j.state = 'completed'
        AND j.name = ANY($1::text[])
      ORDER BY j.name, j.id
      FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
      LIMIT 1000
    ),
    decremented AS (
      SELECT d.child_name, d.child_id, COUNT(*)::int AS n
      FROM jobs.job_dependency d
      JOIN locked_parents p ON d.parent_name = p.name
        AND d.parent_id = p.id
      GROUP BY d.child_name, d.child_id
    ),
    locked_children AS (
      SELECT j.name, j.id, d.n
      FROM jobs.job j
      JOIN decremented d ON d.child_name = j.name
        AND d.child_id = j.id
      WHERE j.blocked
      ORDER BY j.name, j.id
      FOR UPDATE OF j
    ),
    unblocked AS (
      UPDATE jobs.job j
      SET pending_dependencies = GREATEST(j.pending_dependencies - lc.n, 0),
          blocked = GREATEST(j.pending_dependencies - lc.n, 0) > 0,
          start_after = CASE WHEN GREATEST(j.pending_dependencies - lc.n, 0) = 0
            THEN GREATEST(j.start_after, jobs.job_now())
            ELSE j.start_after END
      FROM locked_children lc
      WHERE j.name = lc.name
        AND j.id = lc.id
      RETURNING 1
    ),
    cleared AS (
      UPDATE jobs.job_common j
      SET blocking = false
      FROM locked_parents p
      WHERE j.name = p.name
        AND j.id = p.id
      RETURNING 1
    )
    SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS resolved FROM cleared

WITH
      strict_fifo_heads AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (h.singleton_key) h.id
        FROM jobs.job_common h
        WHERE h.name = 'changes.dispatch'
          AND h.state < 'active'
          AND NOT h.blocked
          AND h.policy = 'key_strict_fifo'
          AND h.start_after <= jobs.job_now()
        ORDER BY h.singleton_key, h.state DESC, h.created_on, h.id
      ), 
      
      
      next AS (
        SELECT j.id
        FROM jobs.job_common j
        WHERE j.name = 'changes.dispatch'
          AND j.state < 'active'
          AND NOT j.blocked
          AND j.start_after <= jobs.job_now()
          AND j.id IN (SELECT id FROM strict_fifo_heads)
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM jobs.job_common b
            WHERE b.name = j.name
              AND b.singleton_key = j.singleton_key
              AND b.state IN ('active', 'retry', 'failed')
              AND b.policy = 'key_strict_fifo'
              AND b.id <> j.id
          )
        ORDER BY j.priority desc, j.created_on
        LIMIT 1
        FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
      )
      
      
      UPDATE jobs.job_common j SET
        state = 'active',
        started_on = jobs.job_now(),
        heartbeat_on = jobs.job_now(),
        retry_count = CASE WHEN started_on IS NOT NULL THEN retry_count + 1 ELSE retry_count END
      FROM next
      WHERE name = 'changes.dispatch' AND j.id = next.id
      
      
      RETURNING j.id, name, data, retry_count as "retryCount", expire_seconds as "expireInSeconds", heartbeat_seconds as "heartbeatSeconds", group_id as "groupId", group_tier as "groupTier",
